reason: This changes INTDIV pushdown to TiKV, which is a semantic/runtime boundary change rather than a local fix. It touches expression evaluation, vectorized arithmetic, distSQL builtin mapping, and pushdown inference, so any mismatch in signedness, overflow, truncation, NULL/error handling, or planner pushdown eligibility can produce wrong results across many queries. That is central and risky enough for a focused Blocker/High review.
